scope: Nominal CAD, native controls, motion/service and exports only; no physical, electrical or flight qualification.

native_tests.execution: Complete native unittest discovery grouped by TestCase class across six isolated FreeCAD Python workers. Class fixtures preserved; exact discovery ID coverage, no skips, frozen production/test/tool sources required.
native_tests.source_unchanged_scope: One complete frozen phase: production/test/tool Python and fixture hashes match before, after and recording.
native_tests.launcher_scope: Observed subprocess return code for this BP native wrapper. Native harness ran in its own session; result data and logs are independently hashed. No prior-run exception is reused.

blender_scope: Sampled prescribed rigid motion, not physical/dynamic/wire simulation.
record_scope: Execution result at recorded_utc; valid only for matching source, native CAD and fixture hashes. Absent generated files must be regenerated and revalidated.
